goals.text: Reach 700 active users by the end of Q2

achievements: Scheduling integration went live on May 18
challenges: User adoption is behind the original plan (about 520 active users vs 700 planned)
Training attendance was lower than expected
risks: Hospital South rollout may slip into Q4 if training resources are not allocated, impacting the annual adoption target

action_items.text: Training team will propose additional sessions

notes: Goal is stated only in narrative (700 planned vs ~520 actual). 'approximately 520' is a rounding of the exact 524, not a conflict. 'Next executive review' is listed under Agreed Activities, so it counts as an action item.
